name.en: National Unified Legal Professional Qualification Examination registration photo
name.zh: 国家统一法律职业资格考试报名照

issuer: Ministry of Justice of the People's Republic of China

notes.en: Provincial announcement published on the Ministry of Justice site for the 2025 objective-item exam (the photo rule is the national format): 413×626 pixels; colour; red, blue, or white background; front-facing, bareheaded; taken within 3 months; JPG; 40–100 KB. Head and shoulders, both ears and both eyebrows visible; head about two-thirds of the photo (approximate wording, so head_ratio is left null). No accessories or thick frames that hide the eyes; no stretching or beautification. Print millimetres and DPI are not stated. Only white is stored as a hex value.
notes.zh: 司法部门户刊登的 2025 年客观题考试公告（照片为全国统一格式）：宽 413 × 高 626 像素；彩色；红/蓝/白底均可；正面免冠；近三个月；JPG；40–100 KB。须显示双肩、双耳、双眉；头部约占照片约 2/3（“约”故 head_ratio 留空）。不得佩戴遮挡五官的饰品或粗框眼镜，不得拉伸、美化。未写印刷毫米与 DPI。色值只记白底。

sources.title: Ministry of Justice: Jilin Justice Department announcement on the 2025 National Unified Legal Professional Qualification objective-item exam (electronic photo rules)
